newsitem.title: CANADA: GSW serves GE in Camco action.
newsitem.headline: GSW serves GE in Camco action.

text.p: Camco Inc said on Friday that GSW Inc, a minority shareholder of Camco, served Camco's majority shareholder, General Electric Co and its Canadian unit General Electric Canada Inc, with a notice of arbitration preserving GSW's rights to hold a private arbitration proceeding regarding a shareholder rights action.

A 1993 agreement between the shareholders set out the terms under which a shareholder rights action commenced by GSW in July 1992 against GE Canada and GE was settled and mutual releases were exchanged.

The agreement contemplated that GSW could reassert the claims made and continue the shareholders rights action if a panel of arbitrators appointed by the shareholders determined that GE and GE Canada had materially breached the understandings set out in the agreement.
As GSW's right to arbitrate would have expried in January 1997, the delivery of the notice preserves GSW's rights to have the private arbitration proceeding held.
Camco said it will not be a party to the confidential proceedings but does not expect the issue to affect Camco operations.
